segments.text: This is the live Crypto Bot app. Once a day it decides whether to hold Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana, or wait in dollars. I'll start it on Solana. With my own wallet, it would sign real swaps. Here I'll pick simulation: real Jupiter quotes and routes, virtual USDC, no risk.

Within seconds it makes its first decision. Each coin is above three of its four moving averages, so the bot holds a quarter of the capital in each and keeps the rest in USDC. The feed explains every trade in plain words, and the next decision comes after the daily close.

Advanced mode shows the reasoning. For every coin: the daily close, its distance to the 20, 50, 100 and 200-day averages, and the target share. Today each coin is below its 20-day average and above the other three. Below are the venue and on-chain settings, the decision journal, and a live log of everything the bot does.

segments.text: For more history, here is the same app replaying the strategy on real 2026 prices since January. It is up about twelve percent, while simply holding the three coins lost about fourteen. Past prices, not a forecast. The interface also switches to Russian and Armenian on the fly.

visual.label: Replay · real 2026 prices · not a forecast

segments.text: The equity curve marks every trade, and the drawdown panel shows how far the capital fell from its peak: under twenty percent this year. When the trends came back in late summer, the bot bought back in. The journal filters trades, checks and errors.

Back to the live session. Stopping is one button: the bot sells everything back to USDC and shows the result next to what simply holding the coins would have given. Crypto Bot: one slow decision a day, from your own wallet, on Solana.
